Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role:

Alpaca is building a differentiated position in primary markets: connecting issuers and lead underwriters to high-quality global retail demand through our brokerage infrastructure and broker-dealer partner network; Equity Capital Markets is a strategic growth engine for Alpaca. 

We're looking for a Director, Equity Capital Markets to own Alpaca's ECM franchise: win issuer-selected allocations, deepen relationships with syndicate and ECM desks at major underwriters, and originate the next wave of investment banking opportunities across IPOs, follow-ons, and other primary offerings.

This person will operate at the intersection of capital markets, issuer coverage, and distribution strategy. You will package Alpaca's global retail reach—especially international and partner-driven demand—into a proposition that issuers and banks choose for retail tranches. You will run live-deal execution end to end, from selling-group readiness through allocation quality and post-deal reporting, while building a durable pipeline of future IB opportunities for Alpaca.

This is not a pure coverage or relationship role. You're building Alpaca's seat at the syndicate table and turning distribution into repeatable primary-market wins that compound into broader investment banking relationships.

What you'll do:

  • Build and own senior relationships with issuers, sponsors, CFOs, IR teams, and bankers to get Alpaca into retail-platform selection processes, data packs, and management conversations—securing meaningful allocations.
  • Develop and deepen coverage of lead underwriters and ECM / syndicate desks across bulge-bracket and select boutique banks; drive selling-group / select-dealer agreements from introduction through execution and operational readiness
  • Position Alpaca's distribution story—global retail reach, broker-dealer partner network, geo / demographic targeting, customer quality, and anti-flipping controls—so issuers and banks prefer Alpaca for retail participation
  • Originate and grow future investment banking opportunities for Alpaca across IPOs, follow-ons, and related primary offerings, with focus on retail-friendly and high-conviction sectors
  • Run live-deal execution: qualify offerings, mobilize partner and end-client demand, coordinate legal / selling restrictions and jurisdictional readiness, manage IOI / order flow, and deliver clean post-deal reporting
  • Build a repeatable ECM operating rhythm—pipeline reviews, banker coverage maps, issuer outreach cadence, and deal retrospectives—that scales with deal volume
  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Product, Brokerage Ops, Partnerships, and Finance to keep Alpaca deal-ready across agreements, marketing materials, restricted jurisdictions, and allocation methodology
  • Represent Alpaca in issuer pitches, banker meetings, exchange / PE channels, and industry conferences; convert introductions into active coverage and signed pathways to allocation
  • Define and track ECM success metrics: issuer pitches and data-pack inclusions, signed selling-group relationships, allocation volume and quality, partner / geo coverage per deal, flipping outcomes, and repeat issuer / bank engagement
  • Manage and grow the ECM franchise over time, including prioritization of bank coverage, sector focus, and the roadmap from retail distribution into broader IB opportunity capture

What we're looking for:

  • 3+ years in equity capital markets, syndicate, equity capital markets origination, or adjacent investment banking / primary markets roles, with clear ownership of issuer and underwriter relationships
  • Proven track record securing allocations and influencing issuer/sponsor selection for retail or distribution partners—ideally across IPOs and other equity offerings
  • Existing senior relationships with ECM / syndicate desks at major underwriters and comfort operating in selling-group / select-dealer constructs
  • Strong issuer coverage instincts: you know how to get into the room with CFOs, IR, sponsors, and bankers, and you can win on substance, not just introductions
  • Deep fluency in how retail tranches, allocation decisions, and syndicate processes actually work—and the judgment to navigate high-demand deals where issuer outreach is required
  • An exceptional operator who can build the playbook: agreements, materials, deal process, partner mobilization, and post-deal feedback loops
  • Clear communicator who can package a differentiated distribution narrative for issuers and banks, align internal stakeholders, and close loops quickly in live deals
  • Comfortable collaborating remotely in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment while showing up for high-stakes in-person issuer and banker meetings when it matters

Preferred:

  • Experience placing or distributing international / non-US retail demand into US or global equity offerings
  • Prior work with broker-dealer networks, introducing brokers, or platform distribution in primary markets
  • Background spanning both sell-side ECM / syndicate and buy-side or platform distribution perspectives
  • Existing relationships across AI, consumer, or other retail-friendly IPO pipelines, and familiarity with exchange / PE origination channels
  • Experience standing up a new ECM or primary-markets function inside a high-growth fintech or brokerage platform

What Success Looks Like:

  • Alpaca is consistently included in issuer retail-platform evaluations and wins meaningful allocations on priority deals
  • Selling-group / select-dealer relationships with key lead underwriters are signed, operational, and actively used
  • A growing pipeline of investment banking opportunities—beyond one-off IPO participation—is originated and advanced for Alpaca
  • Live deals run cleanly: partner demand is mobilized, legal / jurisdictional readiness is never the blocker, and post-deal reporting reinforces Alpaca's quality to issuers and banks
  • Issuers and underwriters return to Alpaca because distribution quality, allocation outcomes, and coverage reliability compound over time

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Digital Trust and Resilience Director to lead our Information Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) programs in South Korea. Serving as the strategic and operational bridge between our executive leadership, local regulators, and engineering teams, you will own K-ISMS / ISMS-P certification, manage internal and external security audits, support statutory filings and VASP license renewals, and drive technical teams to deliver resilient, compliant digital asset infrastructure under South Korea’s evolving crypto regulatory framework.

  • Hands-on familiarity with digital asset custody architectures (cold/warm/hot wallets, HSM, MPC), Travel Rule protocols, and AWS/Azure cloud compliance in South Korea.
  • Knowledge of global regulatory frameworks and demonstrated experience managing regulator relationships across jurisdictions, including GDPR, DORA, CFTC, MiCA, MAS, HKMA, and HK SFC.
  • Strong interest in and practical understanding of blockchain and AI technologies, paired with a collaborative, detail-oriented mindset and commitment to continuous learning.
descriptions.job-18z161f:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Scam Investigations team is TRM’s tip of the spear against pig butchering syndicates, romance fraud networks, and investment scam operations that steal billions from victims each year. The team operates an integrated workflow — from AI-supported complaint triage to time-sensitive investigation, escalation, and recovery support for victims.

As a Global Investigator, you will work at the recovery-focused layer of scam investigation. You will validate high-priority blockchain leads, conduct forward and backward tracing, assess whether funds touch regulated platforms or other actionable endpoints, and produce clear investigative documentation that supports time-sensitive escalation and victim-centered recovery outcomes.

The impact you will have here:

  • Support time-sensitive asset-preservation workflows with regulated platforms and ecosystem partners.

  • Own the recovery side. After a freeze, run the backtrace that ties frozen funds to specific victims and produce the documentation that drives restitution. The freeze is the start. Victim recovery is the goal.

  • Trace victim funds end-to-end — forward to the wallets that consolidate them, backward to the platforms they came from. Your work feeds directly into the legal packages that recover them.

  • Validate time-sensitive blockchain signals and move high-confidence matters through the appropriate escalation workflow. Speed and accuracy both matter.

  • Continuously learn new issues in crypto

  • Support other teams on time sensitive issues that might be unforeseen

  • React timely to the movement of funds during an ongoing investigation

What we’re looking for:

  • Location / citizenship / clearance — placeholder, varies by region (NA seats: US Citizenship required, ability to obtain Public Trust clearance, US-based). EMEA / APAC seat requirements TBD by region.

  • AI fluency (required) — you use AI tools in your workflow to synthesize returns, draft outputs, and accelerate analysis, with examples of how AI has impacted your work.

  • Blockchain / cryptocurrency tracing (required, gating) — forward-then-backward trace, exchange attribution, co-mingling handling, multi-hop VASP tracing, and LIFO/FIFO backtrace for recovery work. Non-negotiable.

  • Creative tactical thinking — demonstrated ability to pivot from a single point to a network view, identifying operators behind operations.

  • Experience producing investigative packages that can support formal legal, compliance, or enforcement workflows.

  • You think in outcomes, not lanes. If “that’s not what I was hired for” is a sentence you reach for, this isn’t the seat.

  • You don’t need a checklist to start. Handed something you’ve never seen, you figure out the first move and take it. When the playbook stops, you keep going.

  • 3–5 years of cryptocurrency investigations or asset-recovery experience — law enforcement crypto units, blockchain analytics firms, exchange compliance investigations, or equivalent. You understand how regulated platforms behave under request, including the difference between voluntary cooperation and formal process, and you treat getting money back to victims as part of your job rather than a downstream handoff.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows

  • All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

  • Weekly team syncs

  • Daily shift handoff call

  • Daily monitoring shift

Team operating rhythms:

  • High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy — work directly with engineering, analysts, legal counterparts, and partners who depend on the team’s output.

  • Distributed, async-first via Slack and Notion, with structured syncs for alignment.

  • Follow-the-sun rotation — the team runs investigators across NA, EMEA, and APAC for around-the-clock coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Corporate Finance team’s mission is to generate accurate and actionable insights for leadership regarding business performance, and communicate them in a way that empowers strategic decision making. We own the company’s consolidated financial picture, including forecasting, planning, and reporting. We translate operating activity into the financial narrative that leadership, the Board, and investors rely on. As the business scales, the team keeps sharpening how we understand and explain performance across Robinhood’s product suite.

As a Corporate Finance Intern, you will join the team during forecast cycles and work with stakeholders across Brokerage, Crypto, and Money. You will help turn granular data into the clear takeaways senior leadership needs to make strategic decisions. You will also contribute to the team’s consolidated model and the reporting used across the Finance org to track key performance indicators. About Mantle

We’re building an AI agent to help families support their aging parents (origin story here).

Over 40M “sandwich generation” Americans currently manage their parent’s affairs. Keeping mom/dad safe and supported is like a second job: it’s time-consuming, stressful and on top of their already busy lives. We believe that managing our parents’ affairs should feel under control, easier and lower stress.

Co-founded by serial entrepreneur partners including Ted Zagat, who sold his previous businesses to Slack (announcement here) and Google (Zagat restaurant guides).

The Role

We’re looking for a Business Lead to creatively solve problems and get things done at Mantle. This is a foundational role for a high-output generalist who wants to build a company from the ground up.

You will work side-by-side with the founders to turn an ambitious vision into reality. This role is for a builder and an executor. On any given day, you might set up an early marketing campaign or leverage AI to automate a manual workflow that’s slowing us down. You’ll have exposure to every facet of our business, from AI agent technology to marketing to product development and everything else. You’ll build the foundation of entire functions, such as customer support.

To be clear: this role is not always sexy. It requires someone willing to handle the unglamorous work and then creatively automate and scale it. You are the person who fills the gaps, solves the "problem of the week," and ensures the team delivers.

What You'll Build

  • Go-to-Market foundations: Execute our initial marketing motions and customer acquisition experiments in coordination with our Head of Marketing.

  • Operational infrastructure: Design the systems and standards that allow a fast-moving startup to scale without breaking.

  • Recruiting engine: Build and run the process that helps us attract and close exceptional talent.

  • Operating cadence: Establish how the company plans, prioritizes, communicates, and delivers on non-technical goals.

  • Special projects: Lead high-priority initiatives across legal, finance, and workplace operations that don't yet have a dedicated owner.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • Fast-growing venture funded startup experience.

  • 3-7 years of high-performance background in marketing, operations, and/or consulting.

  • Proven "Swiss Army Knife": Track record of jumping into unfamiliar areas and delivering results quickly.

  • Extreme ownership: History of taking projects from 0 to 1 with minimal supervision.

  • Strategic & pragmatic: Ability to see the big picture with the willingness to do the manual work required to get there.

Ideal Background

  • Early-stage startup experience where you wore many hats.

  • Experience building functions from scratch (e.g. being the first Marketing or Ops hire).

  • Strong product sense and a clear instinct for what matters to users.

  • Elite academic profile.

Who Thrives Here

  • Builders: You love creating things from scratch and taking full ownership.

  • Scrappy: You operate well without a lot of structure or resources and find ways to "get it done."

  • Great collaborator: You foster great working relationships.

  • Founder-minded: You think like an owner and care deeply about company outcomes.

  • AI native: You embrace modern AI to increase leverage for you and your colleagues.

  • Strategic and pragmatic: You set direction and make practical decisions quickly.

  • Autonomous: You thrive with minimal direction.

  • Mission-driven: You care about helping families navigate the complexities of aging.

What You'll Get

  • Meaningful work: Build a consumer product that will make a real difference in the lives of millions of families, with real ownership, fast pace, and huge financial potential.

  • Founding scope: Shape our business strategy and culture from the very beginning.

  • Partnership with founders: Work closely with Mantle’s co-founders, including involvement in the biggest decisions.

  • Learning & growth: Opportunity to build a category-defining company from the ground up.

  • Real ownership: Your decisions will shape our product, business and culture.
